set -euo pipefail

ENV_FILE=".env.test"

    if nc -z -w $TIMEOUT 127.0.0.1 "$port" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        echo "up"
    else
        echo "down"
    fi
}

# --- Gather port statuses ---

    status=$(check_port "$p")
    port_status["$p"]=$status
    if [[ $status == "up" ]]; then
        echo "✅ Port $p is open (service is running)"
    else
        echo "❌ Port $p is closed (service is NOT running)"
    fi
done

if [[ -f $ENV_FILE ]]; then
    env_json=""
    while IFS='=' read -r key value; do
        # Skip empty lines or lines starting with #

        [[ $key == \#* ]] && continue
        # Trim possible surrounding whitespace

        env_json+="\"$key\":\"$escaped_value\","
    done < "$ENV_FILE"
    # Remove trailing comma
    env_json="${env_json%,}"
else
    echo "⚠️ .env.test not found – sending empty env payload"
    env_json=""
fi

# --- Build the final JSON payload ---

for p in "${PORTS[@]}"; do
    ports_json+="\"$p\":\"${port_status[$p]}\","
done

    payload+=",\"env\":{${env_json}}"

    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d "$payload")

    echo "📨 Health report successfully sent (HTTP $response)"
else
    echo "🚨 Failed to send health report (HTTP $response)"
    echo "Payload: $payload"
    exit 1
fi
EOF
